frontier.hypothesis: A third route to the target join order exists that keeps the @0xE store in the join without a multi-write local: any in-block successor for the arm's trailing li will defeat the sched1 hoist, and the @0xE store is only the most obvious one.
frontier.mechanism: H-s14f-1 established that the hoist is decided by schedule_select's potential_hazard tiebreak among equal-INSN_PRIORITY insns (tools/gcc-2.7.2/sched.c:2706-2721). Any in-block consumer of the arm's last value raises that li out of the store group; if a consumer exists whose own emitted bytes coincide with instructions the target already has in the arm, the carrier local becomes unnecessary and the join keeps all three stores in source order.
